title: Family Group Sheet Update Lag
dataSources: Hints (`genealogy:hint`), cemetery visits (`genealogy:cemetery`), family-photo work (`genealogy:photo`), research ops (`genealogy:ops`).
app: Genealogy and family-history telemetry — Ancestry hints, cemetery visit logs, and photo-restoration queues — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=genealogy:ops branch_name=* accepted_epoch=* sheet_updated_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((sheet_updated_epoch-accepted_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by branch_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures family-sheet update lag by branch for family group sheets.
value: Lag tracking shows which branch create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside family group sheets.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `family-sheet update lag` on `genealogy:ops` events and aggregate them by `branch_name`.
visualization: Table of branch with average and worst family-sheet update lag.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long things take for each branch so you can see where family group sheets slows down.
